model: PENN System 450 with C450CRN-1 Modbus communications control module
applies_to: PENN System 450 modular temperature, pressure and humidity control systems built around a C450CRN-1 Modbus RTU control module (up to 3 sensors and 10 relay/analog outputs), per LIT-12011826 (2021-01-14).
summary: Modular electronic controller for HVAC and refrigeration: up to three sensor inputs drive up to ten relay or analog outputs. The C450CRN-1 control module is a Modbus RTU subordinate that exposes one holding-register image: module info, sensor types, offsets and live values (IEEE floats), sensor failure flags, output types and statuses, and a 13-register setup block per output (referenced sensor, on/off or setpoint/end point, delays, integration, failure mode).

addressing.note: The bulletin lists 4xxxx holding registers and says the address in the request frame is the register address minus 40001 (40001 -> 0).

source.title: System 450 Series Modular Control Systems with Communications Control Modules Technical Bulletin
source.pages: pp. 70-71 (serial setup), pp. 72-87 (Modbus network image: Tables 17-32, addressing, data types, byte order, strings, setpoint write logic)

notes: Source is Johnson Controls' own documentation portal; the same bulletin is offered there as a PDF attachment (LIT-12011826 .pdf).

Float word order: the bulletin says floats are stored most significant byte first and that the Niagara Modbus driver calls this Order3210, i.e. fully big-endian: high word in the lower register (ABCD).
'Integer 16' is defined as a signed 16-bit integer, so all single registers are INT16.
Sensor values, ON/OFF and SP/EP floats are in the units of the referenced sensor's Sensor Type (Table 21 in the bulletin); the Sn-x Units string registers give the units text.

Output setup registers 41n01-41n13 (n = output number, output 10 uses 42001-42013) mean different things for relay and analog outputs; both meanings are given in each name. The bulletin lists the analog SNF in 41n13 and the analog dead band in 41n12.
Serial defaults are not stated: address 1-247, baud 9600/19200/38400, parity none/odd/even and 1 or 2 stop bits (2 only with no parity) are set in the module UI.

integration.summary: Set address, baud, parity and stop bits on the C450CRN-1 Communications Setup screens, set the EOL switch on the end device, then read 40100-40110 to learn which outputs exist and poll sensor values (40301-40318) and output statuses (40201-40210). Change setpoints by writing SENS/ON/OFF (or SP/EP) and then any value to the output's Validate register.
integration.enable: Use a C450CRN-1 control module (the only System 450 module with Modbus). In the module UI go to Communications Setup (COMM) and set Addr, bAUd, PAR and STOP.
quirks: Register numbers are 4xxxx: subtract 40001 for the PDU address.
Floats span two registers, high word first.

Setpoint writes are only validated when the Validate register (41n07) is written or all five setpoint registers have been written; invalid ON/OFF or SP/EP pairs (range or minimum differential) are rejected.
setup: Device address 1-247; baud 9600, 19200 or 38400; parity 0 none, 1 odd, 2 even; 1 or 2 stop bits (2 only with no parity).
RS-485 terminals A'+, B'- and C' REF with shielded cable; set the EOL switch On only at the ends of the trunk.
gotchas: Outputs that report type 0 are not physically present; their setup registers have no effect.
If a relay output references a binary-input sensor, its ON/OFF values are ignored.
Changing a sensor type changes ranges and default setup values of the outputs that reference it.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
